articles.description: The second generation Polaroid Go with a 16-count pack of film is only $71.99 at Amazon, a $38 discount from the usual price.

articles.title: MacBook Neo 2 Release Date Will Boost Apple’s Spring Sales - Forbes
articles.description: The MacBook Neo 2 is expected to launch in Spring 2027 alongside the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e. It's another step by Apple to split its professional and consumer hardware.
